output.reason: The evidence includes the same substance attributed to “Fair Lending Practice - Penal Charges in Loan Accounts (2023)”: (1) “The REs shall not introduce any additional component to the rate of interest,” and (2) “Penalty… shall be treated as ‘penal charges’ and shall not be levied in the form of ‘penal interest’ that is added to the rate of interest charged on the advances.” It also states that this 2023 item “was withdrawn/repealed… with effect from 2025-11-28,” and that as of 2026-11-23 it is “no longer in force,” which supports the claim that the document is now superseded.
